final_coverage_assessment: PARTIAL. National-level outbreak count data is well-covered for December 2024 and early January 2025 via CDC NoroSTAT (495 outbreaks Aug 1–Dec 11 2024; 91 outbreaks week of Dec 5; 128 outbreaks week prior to Jan 9; 97 outbreaks week ending Jan 9) and corroborated by multiple news/clinical media sources. The Florida DOH Pinellas County epi bulletin provides a January 30, 2025 data point (791 reported outbreaks in 2025 as of that date). CaliciNet data covers the Sep 2024–Aug 2025 season (n=411 confirmed outbreaks). However: (1) February 2025 weekly outbreak counts are not directly surfaced in any snippet; (2) deaths and hospitalizations fields are unaddressed by any snippet; (3) NORS structured outbreak-level records with setting, state, and case-level detail were not returned as a direct result; (4) subnational/locality coverage is thin — only Minnesota (iter1) and Florida/Pinellas County (iter2) appeared as state-level sources; (5) CDC Vessel Sanitation Program cruise ship outbreak records for Dec 2024–Feb 2025 were referenced in CIDRAP but not directly sourced.
final_trustworthiness_assessment: HIGH for national-level data. CDC NoroSTAT and CaliciNet are gold-standard US surveillance systems (cdc.gov domain, CDC Division of Viral Diseases authorship). The Florida DOH Pinellas County epi bulletin (pinellas.floridahealth.gov) is an authoritative state-level official source. CIDRAP (cidrap.umn.edu) is a highly credible academic public health news outlet. Contemporary Pediatrics, MDEdge, Infectious Disease Advisor, and CBS News are credible secondary sources that cite CDC data directly. The restoredcdc.org mirror and fbplans.com are lower-trust secondary sources and should not be treated as independent evidence. Facebook, YouTube, and Instagram results were appropriately excluded.
